summary: Candidate polishD (src/09c_room.js only for THE Room), rated from round/room/before vs after, the same cameras. There is no regression: the calibration regions are pixel-identical (q06 door L167, q06 near shell L62, q09 wall L54, q08 band L102). (1) Toe kick: the concept, colour and recess are confirmed by c_27312 and by in-flight omaat_room_4 (downloaded to ref/web/room). The photos show a near-black base (c_27312 x430-455 y480-510 reads L2-7) set back under the aisle ash panels and monument ends. In the render the kick reads L3-30 and recessed in kick/kick3, and the grey flush band is gone. Two real-photo mismatches remain. The kick looks short: c_27312 gives ~32 px of black under ~240 px of ash on a 1.12 m end, i.e. ~0.10-0.14 m against 0.08. And in both photos a thin silver rail runs directly above the kick, with a pale lower ash panel above that on the monument end. The model has a charcoal frame rail plus a 2 cm grey shell sliver instead. (2) The 11A hairline is gone: in the fw11A crop 590-615 x 330-412 the count above L200 went 48 -> 0 (max 246 -> 128). The only residue is 2-3 isolated L75 edge speckles, which is not an artefact at this resolution. (3) The 9 mm round cap rails are visually neutral to slightly positive. Edges are softer in q10 and q06, but no thin highlight appears: the q06 cap profile is unchanged within ±8 L, while c_27314 shows a L188-251 1-2 px edge line. No z-fighting, gaps, floating parts or light leaks were found in any of the 8 views. The kick box bottom is coplanar with the floor, but it is hidden. The window pink differences in q08/q10 are sky/lighting, not room. The score holds at 8.5. The kick change is a real fidelity gain on the bases but too small to move the overall score.
